description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who rated various criteria on a scale from 0 to 6, with the vertical axis labeled “Criterion” listing the categories in descending order of participant count: “Relevant FCs” (6), “FC Summary” (5), “Relevance Explanation” (3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (3), “Overall Summary” (2), “Filters” (1), and “Veracity Explanation” (1). The horizontal axis is labeled “Number of Participants” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar’s length corresponds to the number of participants who selected that criterion, with the bar color varying for each category: “Relevant FCs” is dark purple, “FC Summary” is dark blue, “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” are teal, “Overall Summary” is green, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are olive green. The chart visually emphasizes the highest-rated criterion, “Relevant FCs,” which received 6 participants, and the lowest-rated criteria, “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation,” which each received 1 participant. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding and length.
